Rashi on Nedarim 32a:10:1.english: Anyone who conducts himself with wholeheartedness - [He] acts wholeheartedly with him.

Rashi on Nedarim 32a:12:1.english: Anyone who divines - That is to say, [one] who pursues diviners.

Rashi on Nedarim 32a:12:2.hebrew: לו נחש - אחריו רודפין ניחושין, דכל דקפיד קפדי בהדיה:
Rashi on Nedarim 32a:12:2.english: To him [is] divination - Omens pursue him, for anyone who is particular [about them], they are particular with him.

Rashi on Nedarim 32a:12:3.english: With lamed alef - Which implies that [divinations] do not pursue him.

Rashi on Nedarim 32a:12:4.hebrew: מדה כנגד מדה - דבמדה כאדם מודד בה, מודדין לו, ולא נפיק מקרא:
Rashi on Nedarim 32a:12:4.english: Measure for measure - For with the measure with which a person measures, they measure to him, and it is not derived from a verse.

Rashi on Nedarim 32a:13:1.hebrew: שנאמר כי לא נחש - כל זמן שאינו מנחש, מה כתיב בתריה? "כעת יאמר ליעקב" — כלומר, עדיין יהא אותו עת דמלאכי השרת יהיו שואלין אותו שאינו מנחש "מה פעל אל", לפי שהוא נכנס למקום שאין מלאכי השרת יכולין ליכנס:
Rashi on Nedarim 32a:13:1.english: As it is stated, "For there is no divination" - As long as he does not practice divination, what is written after it? "At [this] time it will be said to Jacob" — that is to say, that time will still come when the ministering angels will ask the one who does not practice divination, "What has God wrought?" because he enters a place that the ministering angels cannot enter.

Rashi on Nedarim 32a:15:1.hebrew: שהפריז על מדותיו - שהגדיל לישאל על מדותיו של הקב"ה, שאמר במה אדע:
Rashi on Nedarim 32a:15:1.english: That he went to excess regarding His attributes - That he asked excessively about the attributes of the Holy One, Blessed be He, in that he said, “Whereby shall I know?”

Rashi on Nedarim 32a:15:2.hebrew: תן לי הנפש והרכוש קח לך - ולא היה לו לעשות כן, שהיה לו לגיירם:
Rashi on Nedarim 32a:15:2.english: Give me the people and take the goods to yourself - And he should not have done so, for he should have converted them.

Rashi on Nedarim 32a:16:1.hebrew: שהוריקן בתורה - שלימדם תורה, כאדם שמריק מכלי זה לתוך כלי זה, כך הוא לימדן תורה:
Rashi on Nedarim 32a:16:1.english: That he showered them with Torah - That he taught them Torah; like a person who pours from one vessel into another vessel, so did he teach them Torah.

Rashi on Nedarim 32a:16:2.hebrew: שהוריקן - לשון ציהוב, שנא' (תהלים סח) ״ואברותיה בירקרק חרוץ״, שנתן להם זהב הרבה:
Rashi on Nedarim 32a:16:2.english: That he showered them [shehorikan] - An expression of yellowing [like gold], as it is stated (Psalms 68[:14]): "and its pinions with greenish-yellow gold [yerakrak charutz]" — [meaning] that he gave them much gold.

Rashi on Nedarim 32a:17:1.english: Eliezer - [He] was equal to all of them.

Rashi on Nedarim 32a:17:2.hebrew: אליעזר הוא חושבניה - דאליעזר בגימטריא שמונה עשר ושלש מאות, שלא היה עמו אלא אליעזר לחוד:
Rashi on Nedarim 32a:17:2.english: Eliezer is [referred to, as] his numerical value [is this] - For [the name] Eliezer in gematria [equals] three hundred and eighteen, [meaning] that no one was with him except Eliezer alone.

Rashi on Nedarim 32a:18:1.hebrew: מאה ושבעים ותרתין - דהכי משמע: עקב — כמנין עק"ב שנים שמע אברהם בקולי, וכל שנותיו היו קע"ה. אלמא בן שלש שנים הכיר את בוראו:
Rashi on Nedarim 32a:18:1.english: One hundred and seventy-two - For this is what [the verse] implies: "ekev" — according to the numerical value of ekev [172] years, Abraham hearkened to My voice, and all his years were 175. Thus, at three years old he recognized his Creator.

Rashi on Nedarim 32a:1:1.hebrew: מפני שנתעסק במלון תחלה - ואח"כ במילה, והיה לו להתעסק במילה תחלה. ואותו מלון סמוך למצרים, דלא היה סכנה, ואותו התינוק לא היה באותה שעה אלא בן שמונה ימים:
Rashi on Nedarim 32a:1:1.english: Because he was occupied with lodging first - And afterward with circumcision, and he should have occupied himself with circumcision first. And that lodging-place [was] near Egypt, so there was no danger, and that infant was at that time only eight days old.

Rashi on Nedarim 32a:4:1.english: To kill them - those two angels.

Rashi on Nedarim 32a:4:2.hebrew: גונדא דחימה - חיל שלו, אבל איהו גופיה נהרג:
Rashi on Nedarim 32a:4:2.english: The army of Ḥeima - His troop, but he himself was killed.

Rashi on Nedarim 32a:6:1.hebrew: שהיא שקולה כנגד כל המצות שבתורה - דכתיב (שמות כ״ד:ח׳) הנה דם הברית אשר כרת ה' עמכם על כל הדברים האלה, וכתיב במילה (בראשית י״ז:ב׳) ואתנה בריתי וגו', כרתי ברית וגו', וכתיב להלן (שם) ואתנה בריתי. מה להלן ברית, אף כאן ברית:
Rashi on Nedarim 32a:6:1.english: That it is equal to all the mitzvot in the Torah - For it is written (Exodus 24:8): "Behold the blood of the covenant that the Lord has made with you concerning all these words," and it is written regarding circumcision (Genesis 17:2): "And I will establish My covenant, etc." [And in our verse it states:] "I have made a covenant, etc.," and it is written there (Genesis 17:2): "And I will establish My covenant" — just as there [it refers to the] covenant [of circumcision], so too here [it refers to the] covenant [of circumcision].

Rashi on Nedarim 32a:6:2.hebrew: אם לא בריתי יומם ולילה - מה להלן תורה, אף כאן תורה. והיינו פליגא, דהכא מוקי לה להאי קרא במילה, והתם מוקי לה בתורה:
Rashi on Nedarim 32a:6:2.english: If My covenant be not with day and night - Just as elsewhere [the phrase "day and night" refers to] Torah, so too here [it refers to] Torah. And this is [what is meant by the Gemara's statement] "and it disagrees": for here it establishes this verse as [referring to] circumcision, whereas there [Rabbi Eliezer] establishes it as [referring to] Torah.

Rashi on Nedarim 32a:8:1.hebrew: שמא נמצא בי דבר מנוגה - (עד) עכשיו, שלא אמר לו "והיה תמים" עד עכשיו:
Rashi on Nedarim 32a:8:1.english: Perhaps something disgraceful has been found in me - (until) now, since He had not said to him, "and be wholehearted," until now.
